title: From 20 Minutes to 7: Hunting the Hidden Waits in Our Merge Queue
summary: A few months ago an average Merge Queue run took 16-22 minutes. Now it's 6-8. The savings came from finding places where the workflow was waiting on a managed service to do nothing: internal stabilization periods, consistency checks we didn't need, single-threaded cache downloads.
